documented_cascades.name: Vandiyur Tank Cascade System (VTCS)
documented_cascades.narrative: Eight-tank gravity cascade across six catchments documented in the academic literature as the textbook Madurai cascade. Rural feeder tanks at the head, urban tanks at the foot, terminates in Vandiyur Lake before joining the Vaigai river.

source.citation: Chinnasamy P., Srivastava A. (2021). Revival of Traditional Cascade Tanks for Achieving Climate Resilience in Drylands of South India. Frontiers in Water 3:639637.

court_anchor.case: R. Manibharathi v Union of India, WP(M) 31214/2023
court_anchor.summary: March 2024 order on Vandiyur and Thenkal Kanmoi tank bund-road encroachment; directed TN to publish a state water-bodies registry within 6 months.

documented_cascades.name: Kondagai-Piramanur-Palayanur Vaigai-fed cascade
documented_cascades.narrative: Vaigai surplus diverted via head-sluice and 9.6 km link canal into a three-tank chain that ultimately drains to the Girudhumal river. Documented in the TN PWD-WRD IAMWARM Detailed Project Report - the gold standard for engineering provenance.

source.citation: TN PWD/WRD. Restoration and Regradation of Girudhumal river. IAMWARM Package 01/IAMWARM/WRD/GML-River/Works/V/2012-2013.

edges.notes: Silaman head sluice + Melavellore Dividing dam.

documented_cascades.name: Madakulam Pandya cascade (12th century CE)
documented_cascades.narrative: Five-step cascade documented in a 12th-century Pandya inscription, with channel originally named Nattatrupuram and later renamed Viranarayana kulakeel. Madakulam itself preserves a Pandya-era stone sluice and inscription.

source.citation: Joshima M., Sundarapandian S. M. (2019). Vaigai River Madurai. JETIR 6(8):JETIR1908A90; Madakulam Wikipedia entry referencing Raja Raja Chola I inscription and Pandya Paranthaka Viranarayanan.

edges.notes: Pandya-era Nattatrupuram channel renamed Viranarayana kulakeel.

documented_cascades.name: Mullaperiyar to Madurai engineered supply chain
documented_cascades.narrative: Inter-state trans-basin transfer: Mullaperiyar reservoir in Kerala feeds the Vaigai catchment in Tamil Nadu via a tunnel through the Western Ghats; Vaigai dam regulates the flow which then reaches Madurai via the Periyar Main Canal, the Thirumangalam Canal, the Vaigai bed, and finally the Pannaipatty WTP. Included here as an engineered NEGATIVE-CONTROL case so the scorer can distinguish documented engineered transfers from algorithmically-predicted natural cascades.

source.citation: ADB Tamil Nadu Urban Flagship Investment Program (TNUFIP) Tranche 2 Initial Environmental Examination, project 49107-005, December 2025.

court_anchor.summary: 2014 SC verdict permitting 142 ft storage; ongoing supervisory committee.
